name: Heroku MCP
description: Lets agents deploy and manage Heroku apps through a remote OAuth MCP server or the Heroku CLI, covering dynos, add-ons, pipelines, logs, and Postgres.

skills.name: App Deployment
skills.description: Creates, renames, and transfers apps, and deploys projects to Heroku with an app.json configuration.

skills.name: Dyno Management
skills.description: Lists, scales, resizes, and restarts dynos, and runs code or commands on a sandboxed one-off dyno.

skills.name: Pipeline Promotion
skills.description: Creates, lists, and inspects pipelines, and promotes apps to the next stage in a Heroku pipeline.

skills.name: Postgres Operations
skills.description: Runs SQL with pg_psql, inspects active queries, locks, and outliers, and manages Heroku Postgres backups and upgrades.

skills.name: Logs And Maintenance
skills.description: Views application logs, turns maintenance mode on or off, and lists or provisions add-ons for an app.
